preserve: all 80 questions verbatim, including their gold fields
method: Cross every subject with all eight properties except the missing properties needed for the six controls. Add a fresh value for each missing cell, in subject and property declaration order. primary_score: first pass only; separate answered / assumed / proposal / held and expected-unanswerable; compare gold fact ID, value, and claim where present; show candidates separately
check_probe: natural 4 unchanged; compare with explicit lookup and independent literal. Also include paired unknown-condition and novel-literal controls. No score pooling with original questions.
